audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0].side and phases[3].side read Skill while content win[N] and packet.levelChart read Orianna and Lux.
audit.why: Level 1 Lux has one damage spell and no root angle, so the ball plus an auto wins that exchange. Levels 4-5 are hers because Light Binding into Lucent Singularity plus the Illumination auto is a full trade Orianna has no dash to leave. The other five rows already agreed.
audit.corrected: Two sides moved onto the content chart with their whys rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown appeared anywhere in the spike or cooldown prose.
audit.why: Light Binding is 10s flat at every rank — unusually punishing to waste, and the cleanest commit window in the lane. Lucent Singularity is 10s at rank 1, Final Spark 60s at rank 1, against your 9s E and 110s R.
audit.corrected: Those numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, both Do's bullets and the level 6 row.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t all claimed you can "minion-block" Light Binding, and breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit. Two bullet bodies were tradeGood/tradeBad pastes.
audit.why: Riot's own text says Light Binding binds and damages up to two enemy units. A single minion in the line therefore does NOT stop it — the spell continues to a second target, which is you. You need a second body in the path, or you sidestep. Stating it as a one-minion block is advice that gets a reader rooted.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to say it binds up to two units, so one minion is not cover. report[5].t carries the same error and is flagged in notes rather than edited, to stay inside the two-report cap.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Illumination tell was never written down, and 28 misgendering defects had Lux called he/his.
audit.why: Illumination charges the target on any damaging spell and her next attack ignites it, so her walk-up for that auto is the real cue. champ-gender.js lists lux as female.
audit.corrected: breakdown.early now carries the Illumination tell; all flagged fields rewritten with she/her.

notes: Substantive correction: three fields told the reader to minion-block Light Binding. Riot's text says it binds up to two enemy units, so one minion is not cover — the spell carries through to a second target. Two of those fields are fixed here; report[5].t still contains the same wrong advice and needs the same correction, left only because of the two-report cap. Chart rows 0 and 3 moved the full layer onto the content layer, which already matched packet.levelChart — win[N] therefore already holds the correct values and no paired content edit exists; both moved rows had their whys rewritten in the same proposal. The kit file's derived flags mark Illumination as an autoReset and the missingInteractions entry repeats that, but Riot's description says only that her next attack ignites the charge — it does not describe an attack reset. I wrote the walk-up-for-the-auto tell, which the description does support, and asserted nothing about a reset. report[8].t again carries the stray "the moment Zed hits 6" line common to these Orianna pages.
